scope: Re-evaluation of previously excluded candidates where availability or shutdown status was not conclusively established. These candidates remain outside the active directory but are not described as discontinued unless an official sunset or shutdown is confirmed.

statusWatch.name: Coral AI
statusWatch.reason: The last-known official domains did not yield a verifiable product page during this review. No official shutdown notice or current first-party product documentation was found. This is unresolved; the product is not declared discontinued.
statusWatch.nextAction: Recheck the official site or obtain first-party product documentation or a status announcement.

statusWatch.name: CSM AI
statusWatch.reason: An acquisition by Google has been reported, but no first-party post-acquisition product availability or shutdown statement was found. CSM AI remains excluded from the active directory pending official confirmation; it is not classified as discontinued.
statusWatch.nextAction: Look for an official Google or CSM statement identifying the current product destination or confirming its closure.

statusWatch.name: Firebase Studio
statusWatch.reason: Google confirms new workspace creation and new user signup were disabled on 2026-06-22. Existing workspaces remain usable until 2027-03-22, when Firebase Studio shuts down. It is excluded from new-user discovery but is not described as already shut down.
statusWatch.nextAction: Recheck after 2027-03-22 and direct existing users to Google's migration guide.

statusWatch.name: Hour One
statusWatch.reason: Wix's official press release confirms acquisition of Hour One's team and technology, but no current standalone product page or official shutdown statement was verified. It is excluded pending confirmation whether the product remains independently usable or has been integrated into Wix; this is not a claim that the technology ceased to exist.
statusWatch.nextAction: Verify current standalone availability or an official migration/product transition.

notes: Coral AI: excluded pending official product-status evidence; no shutdown claim is made from domain timeouts.
CSM AI: acquisition reporting exists, but no first-party post-acquisition product availability or shutdown statement was verified; status remains unresolved.
Hour One: Wix's acquisition of the team and technology is confirmed, but standalone product availability and formal shutdown status remain unresolved.
Firebase Studio: Google officially disabled new signups and workspace creation on 2026-06-22 and scheduled shutdown for 2027-03-22; existing workspaces remain usable until then.
